messages:
incbot: PAGER: P0 - model inference errors and tokenizer failures for model 'axiom-7b-v1' observed since 15:32 UTC. Error rate ~2% and latency spike on /v1/generate. Paging on-call.
sara_eng: seeing lots of "batch failed" logs on canary nodes, errors look like tokenization exceptions.
mike_oncall: I'm oncall — taking. starting triage. what customers affected?
jess_prod: small set of enterprise customers in EU see 502s & garbled outputs. Frontend retries increase latency for others. Impact ~1.8% requests overall but high P99 for some routes.
lucas_research: dug into artifact catalog — weightset SHA expected: 1f9a2b... but node reports weightset id: 4b7c9d... that doesn't match pinned release. tokenizer vocab checksum also mismatched.
cicd_bot: deploy pipeline completed: canary promotion job finished for tag canary/axiom-7b-v1:2026-03-17-2145 -> promoted to canary
sara_eng: that promotion looks suspect. can anyone confirm artifact pointers on the bundle service?
lucas_research: run: ```curl -s https://artifacts.internal/release/canary/axiom-7b-v1/meta.json | jq .weights_sha``` expected 1f9a2b..., actual "4b7c9d0a..."
anya_support: customer reported "weird tokens in output, sequences with <unk> and crashes" — they provided logs.
mike_oncall: OK likely cause: promotion script pinned the alias to latest weights (v2) accidentally. sounds like a tag alias race; tokenizer from v1 vs weights from v2 => vocab mismatch.
ryan_sre: can we kill traffic to canary and fallback to stable immediately? what's the feature flag name for canary routing?
sara_eng: flag is feature.canary_axiom_routing. flip to false to remove canary traffic.
ryan_sre: executing safe flip now: ```# redwoodctl
redwoodctl flags set feature.canary_axiom_routing false --env=prod && redwoodctl routes refresh``` applying :gear:
mike_oncall: flip applied at 15:40 UTC. monitoring.
jess_prod: customer error rate dropping. backend 502s trending down. :white_check_mark:
lucas_research: confirming model instances now serving stable weights: nodes report weights sha 1f9a2b... and tokenizer vocab checksums match.
sara_eng: recommended immediate rollback of canary promotion and audit promote script. who can run rollback on the artifact alias?
cicd_bot: rollback job available: `promote --to alias/canary/axiom-7b-v1 --artifact 1f9a2b...` but need approver.
mike_oncall: I'll approve and run rollback. Running in 2 min and will monitor.
mike_oncall: rollback complete at 15:47 UTC. verified alias points to 1f9a2b..., canary nodes reloaded configs.
any_support: confirmed customer-facing issue fully mitigated per customer logs and support tickets updated.
ryan_sre: leaving oncall to follow-up, handing to sara_eng and lucas for root cause and postmortem. mike -> ryan handoff: I'm staying for infra checks, handing long-term to sara.
sara_eng: will own postmortem. initial notes: root cause = promote script race that allowed alias resolution to current-latest instead of pinned artifact; missing checksum verification during promotion; tokenizer/weight mismatch caused tokenization exceptions when weights and vocab out-of-sync.
lucas_research: action items: 1) add strict checksum validation to promotion (block on mismatch), 2) add canary circuit-breaker to auto-failover when tokenizer exceptions > threshold, 3) add artifact pinning test to CI.
mike_oncall: created incident ticket INC-2026-0317-axiom-mismatch and linked logs, timestamps, commands run.
jess_prod: customer outreach: support queued notifications to affected customers and offered rollback remediation. no data loss reported; only degraded availability.
ryan_sre: monitoring for 30m, will schedule retrospective. thanks all for fast flip. :thumbsup:
